scoring_justification: Phonon frequency is recomputed from agent's CSV by locating the mode closest to 2.7 THz; PDOS is structurally audited.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported phonon frequency target (2.7 THz) and tolerance 0.3 THz
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly from the published article; tolerance accounts for functional/pseudopotential differences
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Value taken verbatim from the paper; no synthetic labels.

outputs.description: Gamma-point phonon frequencies computed by DFPT. The mode closest to 2.7 THz is scored by exact match within a tolerance.
Projected density of states onto Ta d and Te p orbitals. The shape is audited: Ta d states should dominate above -2 eV and Te p states below -4 eV.

output_contract.notes: The relaxation log (relaxation_log.txt) produced by the process step is not scored but documents that the required geometry relaxation was executed.
